## Checklist

- [ ] I changed the canonical source rather than patching a duplicated explanation.
- [ ] I preserved the inspect/propose/approve/implement boundary.
- [ ] I did not introduce a fixed document set without a concrete project need.
- [ ] I updated synchronized English and Chinese entry documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked local links and Skill structure.
- [ ] I removed secrets, personal paths, private project names, and confidential examples.
- [ ] I stated what remains unverified.
